design_basis: Planning installation: P1/P2 four ring legs grouped in bank A; P3/P4 four ring legs bank B; P5/P6/P8 three10mm2 radials bank C; P7 separate. Physically segregate banks and lighting to prevent additional grouping. No insulation contact.
source: EMSD2025 Table6(1) PDF57 ring corrected capacity>=20A and max100m2; radial32 max50m2; A6(1) PDF282/283; A5(1) PDF274; A5(3) PDF275
limitations: Socket branch13A capacity is FCU rating, not appliance nameplate demand
All accessory/junction terminals must accept selected main cables; 6/10mm2 are not assumed to fit socket terminals
Raised floor/ceiling method and penetrations remain proposed; mechanical protection and access require review
Power phases and final incoming demand must be recomputed after adoption
